siteMeta.title: gridscore — Grand Prix predictions & live leaderboard
siteMeta.description: Call pole, podium, fastest lap and more before every session. Points land the moment results are in; climb the season leaderboard and your private leagues.

home.headline: Call every session. Score every weekend.
home.lede: Pole, podium, fastest lap, first retirement, safety car. Each call locks when its session starts, and points land the moment results are in.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to gridscore with a magic-link email to submit your calls and join the leaderboard.
signIn.lede: We use your email only to identify your picks. No spam, no digests — just enough to put your name on the leaderboard.
signIn.bullet1Copy: Pole locks at qualifying, the rest at lights out. Edit freely until then.
signIn.bullet2Copy: Standings move the moment a result is confirmed.
signIn.bullet3Copy: Invite friends with a code and race on your own table.
signIn.cardLede: Use your email. We'll create the account on the fly if it's your first time.
signIn.newHere: New here? Just enter your email — your account is created instantly.
signIn.checkInboxBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires soon.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: Markets, locks, points and multipliers explained.
howItWorks.headline: How it works
howItWorks.lede: One weekend, several calls. Each locks on its own session, and each result pays out on its own.
howItWorks.marketsLede: Points per market for the {season}. Admins can tune these; the table always shows the live values.
howItWorks.podiumIn: Driver on the podium, wrong spot
howItWorks.multipliersLede: Every market of a weekend is multiplied. Final points round half up.
howItWorks.multiplierRounds: {count, plural, =0 {No weekends} one {# weekend} other {# weekends}}
howItWorks.locksBody: Pole locks when qualifying starts, the sprint winner when the sprint starts, everything else at lights out. The database refuses late writes; the countdown is just a courtesy.
howItWorks.editBody: Change a call as often as you like until it locks. The last saved version counts.
howItWorks.tiesBody: More perfect podiums first, then more exact calls, then whoever made their first call earlier.
howItWorks.adminBody: Pole, podium, fastest lap and sprint winner come from the timing data. First retirement is suggested by the data and confirmed by an admin; the safety car is entered by an admin.
